pages.text: Altered from $(5)Protection$(), $(4)Elemental Deviation$() increases resistance against projectiles, fires and explosions. The downside is that it decreases the defensive value of the armor it is put on. Maximum level is $(4)IV$() and it conflicts with $(5)Protection$(), $(5)Fire Protection$(), $(5)Blast Protection$(), $(5)Projectile Protection$(), $(4)Algid Resistor$(), $(4)Atheism$() and $(4)Vigor$().

pages.title: Notes
pages.text: While it does provide exceptional defense against the resisted damage types, Elemental Deviation's downside is quite major. The armor value loss is negligible against the resisted damage types but will be felt when the user gets damaged by anything else. It is best used on only one or two armor pieces at once.
